note: Parameters derived from measured METEC 2024 data for a synthetic plant history; not plant measurements

wind.basis: Measured METEC 2024 sonic anemometer minute means, time-shifted; direction rotated so the dominant sector matches the plant scenario westerly design wind; speeds unchanged

background.basis: AERIS-2m minutes with no METEC release active (5 min before start to 20 min after end); diurnal profile and AR(1) variability re-centred on the plant 2.0 ppm background
